# 25-11-07_question

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
theme_set(theme_minimal())
theme_update(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)
library(ggclassify)
library(simplex)
library(patchwork)

library(tidyclust)

kmeans_spec_5 <- k_means(num_clusters = 5) |> set_engine("stats")

set.seed(17)

x <- rbind(matrix(rnorm(100, sd = 0.3), ncol = 2),
           matrix(rnorm(100, mean = 1, sd = 0.3), ncol = 2))
colnames(x) <- c("x", "y")
cl <- kmeans(x, 5)
```

## Repeating the same plot with the same data, but getting different results

### First run

```{r, fig.width=8}
kmeans_spec_5 <- k_means(num_clusters = 5) |> set_engine("stats")

set.seed(17)

x <- rbind(matrix(rnorm(100, sd = 0.3), ncol = 2),
           matrix(rnorm(100, mean = 1, sd = 0.3), ncol = 2))
colnames(x) <- c("x", "y")
cl <- kmeans(x, 5)

ggplot(x, aes(x,y))+
  stat_point_cluster(method = kmeans_spec_5,
                     aes(col = after_stat(cluster)))+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
~plot(x, col = cl$cluster)
```

Across all these plots there are a couple variations in how kmeans 
works for tidyclust, despite using I believe the same kmeans code.
